decisions.statement: A writer of a seat page that can await the write imports this module and calls this module.
A write that cannot await runs this module as a program rather than calling this module.
A run names the seat that run writes for with --agent.
A run given --remove takes the seat page down and states why that page went.
A seat with no composed name and no name in its history is left unwritten.
The report is one line of JSON on stdout with the outcome and the seat.
A refused write exits 1 rather than throwing.
A session or transcript that reads as no record leaves the page unchanged.
A transcript found to have been superseded is written in place of the transcript the run names.
A page that will not state its parent is written again under the parent history gives.

definition: a seat's page written or taken down from what one run of this states
